content.what_it_is: MATLAB benchmark plotting script. It loads one four-gauge measurement table and four FUNWAVE station files, shifts all model time columns by a fixed lag, maps gauge labels 6/9/16/22, and draws four stacked measured-versus-modeled surface-elevation panels (L1-L47).
entities: gauge character matrix and ax limits at L27-L31
calls: clear all at L1; load at L2-L6; clf at L33; subplot, plot, title, ylabel, grid, axis and xlabel at L35-L45
unresolved: The script is in work_case_B but names and applies `time_lag_case_A`. Whether 23.34 is deliberately shared with case A or copied from the wrong benchmark is not documented; a wrong lag shifts every modeled trace.

The horizontal plot coordinate is `t`/`tmodel`, derived from column 1 and explicitly time-shifted, but the x-axis label is `x (m)` at L45. This is a direct units/semantics mismatch; it should identify time and its unit.
The fixed axis [25,41,-0.04,0.06] clips all panels identically without checking loaded ranges. Data outside the expected time/elevation window is silently hidden.

No shape checks precede indexing B.txt columns 1-5 or each station's columns 1-2, and no row alignment is needed because traces are plotted separately. Missing/short files fail at load/index time without a benchmark-specific diagnostic.
Gauge-to-station mapping is encoded only in comments and assignments (6→0001, 9→0002, 16→0008, 22→0013). The mapping cannot be validated from this file and is vulnerable to dataset renumbering.
